note: Generic recipe. Keep the chosen face image, names and scene details in a private place, never in this public repo.
first_pass_template: Photorealistic vertical portrait of a beautiful, approachable woman, {age}, {hair}, {eyes}, flawless natural skin, warm genuine smile, direct eye contact. {outfit}. Standing in {scene}. Soft golden key light, shallow depth of field, shot on a high-end phone. She is alone in the frame. No hands, no name tag, no text, no logo.
prompt_rules: Never put the persona's name in the prompt: it appears as a name tag.
Say 'no hands' and 'alone in the frame', or a stray hand appears.
Vary age, hair and styling between sites, or the faces look alike.
finding_prompt_alone_fails: A prompt rebuilt from a chosen image gives the same style, outfit and setting but a different face. A prompt cannot hold an identity.
finding_edit_model_keeps_identity: The edit model with the chosen image as the reference kept the face, hair and setting across new poses, a new outfit and a new background.

edit_recipe.step_1: Upload the reference once: wavespeed upload <image> (prints a CDN URL; the URL is public, so use AI-made images only).
edit_recipe.step_2: Write a JSON input file. images must be an array: {"prompt": "...", "images": ["<url>"], "size": "768*1024", "seed": 7, "output_format": "jpeg"}. A plain string fails with HTTP 400.
edit_recipe.prompt_pattern: The same woman, same face and hair, now <change>. Keep her identity exactly.

reproducibility: The same model, size, prompt and seed usually give the same image, but a hosted model can change.
video: Use the chosen image, or an edit of it, as the portrait for lipsync. Do not regenerate the person from a prompt for video.
